query:
-- 首先找出 Japanese National Team Pikachu 卡牌的 ID
SELECT id, name, cardNumber, nameJa 
FROM cards 
WHERE name LIKE '%Japanese National Team%' OR nameJa LIKE '%日本代表%'
LIMIT 5;
